earlier_repository_candidates.interpretation: All three bodies were already present as unreviewed OCR-derived retrieval candidates. This source edition adds visual transcription, complete source mappings and explicitly priced repairs, not first computation of the bodies.

interpretation_policy: All monetary amounts and army/reference digits or J/Q/Y labels remain in their published-square form.
The within-message MGD/ARAD comparison supports a declared editorial candidate; it is not an independent exact retransmission.
The raw names FIALA and KUDEL are transcribed without identifying historical individuals.
